report:
Short answer
- The difference (B − A) looks like an added initial-position “echo / example-following” signal: it is concentrated on the first token(s) and, when injected, causes the model to produce identity mappings, simple examples, short code snippets, and “this is a good start” style continuations (i.e., it increases tendency to echo inputs or continue with example/template-like text).

Why I conclude that
- Spatial pattern: the L2 norm is heavily concentrated at position 0 (especially layers ~20–25, with a very large peak at layer 25 pos0). That points to a difference that lives on the early residual stream (an initial-token bias) and is amplified in late layers — exactly where a global tendency to choose a particular high-level continuation would be encoded.
- Patchscope: injecting the difference into an identity prompt repeatedly produces echoing/example-style continuations: “cat -> cat”, “1135 -> 1135”, short code examples, “This is a good start…”, and other explicit echoes or small transformation examples. That is direct behavioral evidence that the vector nudges the model toward copying/illustrative continuations.
- Logit-lens tokens are consistent with instructional/example language: many top tokens across high-norm cells are words/phrases used in examples or instructions (This, Consider/considered, try/try to, prepare/check, simple code-like tokens and numbers). That supports the reading that the difference points in vocabulary-space toward tokens used in example/echo continuations.

Caveats / uncertainty
- The difference is not a clean single token but a distributed vector; some logit-lens cells include other topical words (e.g., “tragic”, “iconic”, place names, etc.), so there may be mixed effects or secondary biases. However, the patchscope readouts strongly support the copying/example-following interpretation.
- I do not claim a specific training objective was changed (e.g., “trained to copy”), only that the functional difference visible in these diagnostics is a stronger propensity to produce identity/example-like continuations driven by an initial-position residual component.
